北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有雾，体感 2℃，出行注意交通安全，添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy with a real feel of 2℃. Drive safely and dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 8℃，出门记得加件外套，别着凉啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with a real feel of 8℃. Remember to wear a jacket when going out!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨，体感 9℃。雨天路滑，记得带伞，注意防滑！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain with a real feel of 9℃. Bring an umbrella and watch your step!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，20℃ 很舒适。别忘了多喝水，保持好心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and a comfortable 20℃. Stay hydrated and enjoy your day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 17℃。天气宜人，出门放松心情吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with a real feel of 17℃. Enjoy the pleasant weather outdoors!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨，体感 7℃。出门记得带伞，小心湿滑路面！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain with a real feel of 7℃. Bring an umbrella and watch for slippery roads!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 4℃，湿度 100%。注意防潮保暖哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy with a real feel of 4℃ and 100% humidity. Stay warm and mind the dampness!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，11℃ 湿度大。记得保持室内通风哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy at 11℃ with high humidity. Remember to ventilate indoors!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雨，体感 8℃，湿度 100%。带好雨具，注意保暖！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has rain with a real feel of 8℃ and 100% humidity. Bring your umbrella and stay warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 3℃，湿度 100%。请注意防寒，多喝热水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy with a real feel of 3℃ and 100% humidity. Keep warm and drink hot water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，14℃。出行务必减速慢行，注意安全！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy at 14℃. Drive slowly and carefully, stay safe!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感-15℃，非常寒冷。务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -15℃, extremely cold. Bundle up completely to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感-6℃，寒意十足。多穿衣物，小心着凉感冒！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -6℃, quite chilly. Wear more layers and watch out for colds!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 5℃。阳光虽好，早晚温差大，注意添衣！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny with a real feel of 5℃. Enjoy the sun, but mind the temp change, dress warmly!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 13℃。舒适宜人，外出散步是个好选择。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with a real feel of 13℃. Pleasant weather, good for a walk outdoors.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 1℃。海风阵阵，出门多穿点，注意保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy with a real feel of 1℃. With the sea breeze, dress warmly when going out!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感-2℃。风力较大，请穿厚外套防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy with a real feel of -2℃. It's windy, wear a thick coat to stay warm.
